about_the_game:
◆ Story

"If you're asking about the rumours…"
"It could only be that one, I suppose?"
"Actually... the master once had a lover."

At the beginning of the 20th century, in a quiet manor isolated from the turbulent times, a “maid”, Anna worked diligently every day and led a monotonous and peaceful life.



However, during an unexpected flashback, the gaps in his memory swept over him. Abnormal colleagues, confused gender, empty cognition, vague dreams...the tranquillity in the past was suddenly replaced by a weird atmosphere. While Anna was at a loss, time began to flow. A group of strangers visited the manor, and a long-hidden mystery quietly unfolded.



The prologue started. As unexpected yet prearranged events took place after another, the strange visitors who claimed to be the family members of the owner of the manor did not bother to hide their abnormal behaviours. Were the various contradictions in their identities, ages, and relationships related to the uneasiness they showed? Some words that shouldn't exist sounded in Anna's ears. What did they have to do with the story?

The curtain rose, and the requiem of fate began to play. Would "Anna" be pushed to the edge of the unknown, or would he jump into the vortex at the centre of the story?

◆ Gameplay

☆ Work:
Dark demons were everywhere in the manor, lurking in the shadows—
You must bring them down ‘with your own hands’! If you are not quick enough, they will rampage throughout the building!
The levels will gradually become more difficult, and more unique mini-games will be unlocked!
There will also be little bonuses hidden in various tasks, waiting for you to discover with attention to details~

☆ Map exploration:
As time goes by, different areas in the manor will gradually unlock, awaiting your exploration.
Outside your main objective, don't forget to unleash your curiosity. Walk around, and you will find in the corners:
★ Interesting conversations
★Characters with secrets

Of course, there’s more⭢
☆ Case investigation:
Murders occurred frequently within the manor, brewing crisis. Each character had their own secrets, and the truth lay hidden in the subtle clues…
You must gather the clues and deduce the process in order to reconstruct the crime scenes and uncover layers of lies.
To uncover the truth, or to go with the flow? It all depends on your choices. Don't be deceived by appearances.


◆ Game Features

☆ A deductive script packed with layers of clues, with 3 side stories available!
☆ Over 25 CGs and illustrations await your discovery!
☆ Cleaning, conversations, map exploration, and even romance with the ‘NPCs’!
☆ Enjoy the multi-twist story and its complex BL relationships!
☆ The voice actors of the three male leads will bring you the most immersive experience with their versatile voices!

content_descriptors.notes: Contains General Mature Content/Mild violence/Bloody scenes.

csrr.descriptors:
依《遊戲軟體分級管理辦法》分類為【輔15級】，您需年滿15歲以上始得使用本遊戲。
本遊戲情節純屬虛構，內容涉及暴力（如攻擊、戰鬥等畫面）、恐怖或不當言語等元素，可能引起部分玩家不適，請審慎評估後使用。
長時間進行遊戲可能影響身心健康與正常作息，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷，並適度休息與運動。
